products.title: The Fermentation Project Box Set
products.body_html:
IMPORTANT NOTES - PLEASE READ:

  • All coffees in this Box Set will be roasted and shipped the week of September 7th (to allow for proper resting time before the live tasting with James.)

  • Any coffees or other items purchased in the same order as this set will ship at the same time. 

  • All coffees will be shipped whole bean.

  • The Box Set is shipped in our fun decorative box. If you are ordering other items, we will ship the Box Set and other items in a larger box together.

  • Complete your experience with a one of a kind artist designed tee, created by our friend Matt deForest Jenkins. 

Same Guatemalan coffee - 4 different processing methods.  An exclusive box set for an unprecedented tasting experience! 

Brio Coffeeworks is thrilled to be participating in The Fermentation Project lead by James Hoffmann and Lucia Solis, an exciting and unprecedented opportunity for coffee fans around the world to join together to explore the unique impacts of different processing methods on a single, exceptional coffeefrom Guatemala's Finca San Miguel Urias.

Here is what's included in your box set: Four (4) 60g bags processed in the following ways. 

The Box Set + Cupping Spoon option includes a Brio-branded rainbow cupping spoon - perfect to break out for the live cupping with James in October!

Meet the Coffee

Want More?

Stay up to date about the tasting event and other project details here. Complete your experience with a one of a kind artist designed tee, created by our friend Matt deForest Jenkins. 

FAQs:

  • When will the Box Set ship? 

The coffees in the box set will be roasted and shipped the week of September 7th to allow for proper rest time prior to the live cupping event on October 3rd with James. 

  • Can I order other items?

You bet! We'd love it for you to experience our other offerings (or grab whatever you need). Please note that if you order other items with this set, everything will be shipped together in September. 

    • What if I want to order something else but need it sooner?

    No problem! If you'd like to have something else sooner, please place a separate order and we will ship that order per our regular shipping schedule. 

    • How is the coffee roasted?

    Each coffee is roasted in our signature Medium-Light to Light profile on the Agtron color scale, ensuring vibrant flavors and delicate nuance.

products.title: Brio Tasting Gift Box
products.body_html:
Includes: Four 8 oz bags

Need a gift but don't know what they like? Can’t decide which coffee is your favorite? Want some variety or to learn more about the flavor profiles you enjoy most? 

We've crafted the Brio Tasting Box with these questions in mind. Featuring four 8 oz bags of the coffees that cover all the bases; It's a great way to experience the nuances of coffees from several coffee-producing countries and a range of our offerings. Gift giving, made simple. Happy sipping & exploring!

Our Regular Tasting Box features some of our favorites single-origin coffees. Curated by our Roaster, you will likely find: 1 natural processed Ethiopia offering, 1 Central American offering, 2 rotating seasonal offerings.

products.title: Calypso
products.body_html:
Dark Chocolate, Cherry, Sweet. 

Calypso pays homage to the classic espresso experience and its decades of tradition. Deep and complex flavors are immersed in a rich, syrupy body. Notes of dark chocolate and cherry dominate, with baking spices emerging as the cup cools. Designed with espresso in mind, it also yields an exceptionally well-balanced drip coffee. The current blend is 60% Costa Rica, 20% Colombia and 20% Brazil.

products.title: Decaf Colombia
products.body_html:
Tasting notes: Chocolate milk, caramel grape. 

 

We're always on the quest to find the most delicious decaf coffees for our decaf drinkers. That is why we're oh so excited for this delicious offering from Colombia. What truly sets it apart is the flavor and character due to the unique sugar cane decaffeination processing (chemical-free ethyl acetate derived from sugar cane). This coffee remains true to its original character, leaving any decaf "taste" behind.  


In the Cup

When we tasted this coffee first on the cupping table, we could hardly tell it was decaf!  What you can expect is lots of sweetness, notes of chocolate and caramel, with a creamy mouthfeel and a pleasant mild acidity.  As with all of our decafs, this coffee was decaffeinated using a chemical-free process.

products.title: Ethiopia Halo Beriti
products.body_html:
Tasting Notes: Raspberry, peach, toffee.

 

In The Cup

Light in body and fruit-forward, this coffee produces a delicate cup with nuanced and clear flavors and aromatics.  Raspberry and peach notes dominate the flavor profile, complemented by a juicy citric acidity.  As it cools, the toffee-like sweetness becomes more apparent, balancing the bright fruit notes.  On espresso, it's best pulled longer to tame the punchy acidity and give more clarity to the fruit notes.

Origin 

Yirgacheffe is one of Ethiopia's most famous coffee-growing regions, known for tea-like coffees that express clear, crisp fruit notes.  Yirgacheffe's coffees are the product of a warm tropical climate with moderate wet and dry seasons. Most coffee is shade-grown by small producers using organic practices. The region's coffees also benefit from high elevations, where specialty arabica thrives.

The Producer

Halo Beriti Washing Station was established in 2014 and serves approximately 750 smallholder producers in the surrounding catchment area. This particular lot is part of a "special preparation" in which hand-sorting was done repeatedly throughout the receiving and drying process, ensuring the highest possible quality.

products.title: Instant Coffee - Calypso
products.body_html:
Cup Profile: Dark chocolate, cherry, sweet.

Serving Suggestion

  • Pour contents of each packet into your favorite cup or travel mug (adjust to preferred strength)
  • Add 8-10oz of filtered water (Make it hot, or cold!). Stir.
  • Sip, sip, sip & enjoy!!
  • Each box contains six 4.5g packets.

This is not your grandma's instant (no offense grandma, we love you!).

Via our partnership with Swift Cup Coffee, we're serving up our favorite blend in this high-fidelity, ultra-convenient format.  

Enjoy the rich chocolatey body of the Calypso Blend. Whether you're adventuring in the woods, sitting on the beach, on a flight, or pretty much anywhere else, you'll love this instant.

Even More Instant

Love a little more brightness in your coffee or prefer a single origin? Try our other Instant options.

products.title: Mexico Chiapas
products.body_html:
Tasting Notes: Brown sugar, orange, praline

 

One of Brio's longest standing relationships is with the CESMACH coop in Chiapas.  Located in the buffer zone of El Triunfo Biosphere Reserve, the member farms are dotted throughout the landscape of the Sierra Madre highlands.  This ideal coffee-growing landscape yields wonderfully sweet and full-body coffees year in and year out.  We're always excited when fresh crop arrives and sad to see it go when we roast the last bag!

In the cup, you'll find mostly sweet and nutty notes, underpinned by a rich full body.  The subtle acidity is reminiscent of fresh oranges, lending complexity to the overall cup.  This coffee is well-suited to both drip and espresso preparations.

A further note about the El Triunfo Reserve; this is one of the most diverse forest reserves in the world and contains Meso-America's largest cloud forest, as well as a protected natural environment for thousands of plant and animal species. To help manage the buffer to adjacent population centers, all of the coffee produced here is shade-grown and organic. 

Learn more about CESMACH from our friends and importing partner, Cafe Imports.

products.title: Belle Epoque
products.body_html:
Strawberry, Brown Sugar, Cocoa 


 

The Belle Epoque is one of our favorite and also our earliest blends. When we first began experimenting with blending coffees of different origins and processing methods, we wanted to create a balanced, multi-purpose coffee that would shine as drip, espresso, or iced and have that “special” something. The result was this coffee, the blend of a rich, chocolate-y Central or South American (rotates seasonally) and a clean, fruit-forward naturally processed Ethiopian. 

The Belle Epoque blend tastes equally good black or with milk. In lattes and cappuccinos, the flavor reminds us of strawberries and cream. Sometimes two different coffees can come together to create something truly new, truly special. The Belle Epoque is proof of that. It’s perfect to sip, savor, and relax with.
